how it works

01

underground

where you become dangerous.

a living world of buried artifacts, suppressed ideas, and unexplored intellectual territory — that maps your thinking over time.

swipe your cyphcard in our underground,
or irl from your apple wallet.

explore underground ideas.

swipe in. pick a route. uncover rare, human-authored treasures your algorithm would’ve never surfaced. your journey becomes a personalized map of how you think.

all resources are human-produced. never ai slop.

02

cyph

where ideas get tested in real time.

a live intellectual ‘cyph’ that resists the echo chamber and places you into productive tension with minds you'd never otherwise meet.

match with cyphers around the world.

open mic

say what you mean. raw, unfiltered, first-person.

office hours

1-on-1. you ask, they answer. no panel, no moderator.

supper club

small room. good food. hard questions.

debate

structured. timed. two sides. one question.

03

irl

no more screen addiction. close the laptop and enter our world of IRL lectures, office hours, supper clubs, & debates.

40+ residencies and venues across nyc

our last cyph...

in the room

demo available upon request.
